authored_by: planning step (LLM) after sampling 5 rows of the audited Portfolio Statement vs schema/sgx_reit_schema.md §2

source.note: Tier C audited Portfolio Statement, located by header text (robust across reports). value_col (carrying value 2025 $'000) decides whether a row is a property row.

skip_col0_regex: ^(Investment properties|Net assets|Non-controlling|Other assets and liabilities|Total|Group|Existing Use|Description of Property)

currency.note: carrying values are SGD-consolidated even for DE/AU assets

valuation_date.note: FS valuation date 31 Dec 2025 (single date for the statement)

property_name.note: <sup> footnotes removed at parse; name-numbers like 'Junction 8' preserved

source_page.note: from cell data-page attribute (+1 -> printed page)

ownership.reason: disclosed in footnotes keyed by the superscript on property_name (e.g. CapitaSky 70%, Gallileo/MAC 94.9%); needs footnote->property mapping

value_basis.reason: 100%-consolidated vs proportionate vs effective-interest; JV/<100% assets need judgement (Gallileo/MAC 94.9% shown at 100%; CapitaSky 70% at 100%)

net_property_income.where: segment-level chart only (p26) — no per-property NPI disclosed

gross_revenue.where: Financial Review by-property table (p25) + per-property cards

lease_expiry_date.where: not in Portfolio Statement (only Remaining Term of Lease) — compute or other page

effective_date.where: land-lease start not disclosed in Portfolio Statement

known_gaps.equity_accounted_jv: ION Orchard (50%) is equity-accounted and NOT in the Portfolio Statement (sits in the Joint Ventures balance-sheet line). Deterministic Tier-C extraction yields 25 rows; ION is a +1 that must come from the JV note / factsheet (needs_llm).

_template_note: CapitaLand-family Portfolio-Statement (Tier C) template. Per new report: update source.html path + consts (symbol/financial_year/valuation_date), re-verify value_col and column indices (3d), and check context_rules match the section headers used.
